header.sub: Choose what shops and customers can see about you. Every change applies immediately.

showInSearch.sub: The “Couriers” list, the map and the platform search.
showInSearch.on: Visible: shops and customers can find you.
showInSearch.off: Hidden: only people who have your profile link can see it.

showRating.sub: Average rating and number of reviews, on your profile, in the list and on the map.
showRating.off: Your rating is hidden (and no longer used for sorting or rating filters).

showDeliveryCount.sub: On your profile and in the couriers list.

shareLocation.sub: Your last GPS position is used to place you on the map and to compute distances.
shareLocation.on: The map uses your last position.
shareLocation.off: The map only places you in your area (neighbourhood or district), never at your exact position.

livreurSecConfidentialite.legalNote: During a delivery, your position is still sent to the tracking of the order in progress, whatever this setting.
